name: Catapult Feather Token
body:
Price 400 gp

DESCRIPTION

This token creates a standard catapult (see Siege Engines). The catapult disappears after 12 hours.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 200 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells major creation, telekinetic assembly
